previousIssues.issue: w7b HIGH / w7a MEDIUM: Type A door-lining furniture mirrored fore-aft vs lalf_133/134
previousIssues.status: fixed. In m18 (looking at L2, forward is on the right), the arming window is upper left (aft), the arc runs from the stop bar by the grip over the top to an arrowhead on the right (forward), and the assist bar runs from the aft housing with the crimson strap on its aft half. This matches lalf_133 (strap x~640 on a bar from 600 to 700) and lalf_134. m13 (R2) and m17 (door 3) are consistent because H=-1 applies on both sides, which suits the forward hinge on both sides. The viewing window is still hidden behind the handle housing, but that is the shell's job (07_shell wz -> c-0.28) and is not scored here.

previousIssues.issue: w7a/w7b MEDIUM: welcome-galley glass door had no pane, frame or round boss
previousIssues.status: partly fixed. m03/m16 now show charcoal stiles all round, a round boss with a latch on the forward stile, and a single cream tag. The pane, however, renders opaque (#2a2a28 at m03 580,250 against lalf_134 #5f5151..#64575e, where the lit shelves and boxes are clearly visible). The 'sheen' quad, tilted 0.1 rad, reads as a dark plank or stick lying diagonally inside the cabinet. See the new medium issue.

details.detail: Door-3 self-service bar (m05, m06, q11). The grey slatted blind replaces the black void. Also present: ash lower doors with round pulls, black counter with rail, monitor, bottle fridge, cups and backlit soffit. Still only ANA's 2019 render to compare against (web search 2026-10-24 again found no in-service photo).

Door-2 welcome galley (m03, m16, m14). The monitor, ovens, chillers, silver brewer cubby, ash doors, framed cabinet, round boss and tag match lalf_134 / omaat_room_32. The smoked pane is too opaque, and the diagonal sheen strip reads as an object inside the cabinet.
Door-2 aft monuments (m04, m13). The ash wall with alu-framed flaps and red top latches matches lalf_133. The R2 jump seat sits on a plain panel.

F front wall, flight-deck door, door 1 (q01, m01, m02, m19). The ink-cloud wall, the ebony corridor, and the cockpit door with its frames and yellow kick strip are good. The drape colour is now right, but the drape still hangs as a free column in the passage.
Lavatory exteriors (m17, q11, m11). The ash J lavs with the white strip, grab and occupancy sign, and the white PY/Y lavs, are unchanged.
F/J bulkhead, J face and J backs (m07, m14, m15). The cream walls, blue-topped literature pockets and tied charcoal curtains are clean.
J/PY bulkhead, PY face (m08, q13). The charcoal-framed landscape monitors, handle bar, bag-hook plate and tied curtain all match alv_IMG_7207/7209.
Door-4 group (m09, m10). The galley bank is consistent, and the wide navy PY aft drapes look right.
Rear, door 5 (m11, m12, q19). The work aisle is credible. The layout follows the seat map only, and the overhead is a flat white light box (lighting).
Standard galley inserts (m01, m09, m12, q19). The alu ovens, black brew heads with jugs, red latches, labels and placard are all there.
Curtains overall. The J, PY and rear curtains are good. The F front drape position is the weak point.

Jump seats + Type A door linings (m13, m17, m18). The lining layout now matches lalf_133/134 for arming window, arc, arrowhead, grip and strap side, and the arc colour is a close crimson-magenta. The handle housing covers the viewing window until the shell moves it.

issues.problem: The smoked pane is effectively opaque, so the shelves and boxes behind it barely show. A diagonal light-grey strip across the pane (the 'sheen' quad) looks like a plank or stick leaning inside the cabinet, not a reflection.
issues.evidence: m03 pane #2a2a28 (580,250) and #2c2c29 (600,350), vs lalf_134 cabinet interior seen through the glass at #5f5151 / #64575e / #4f3d3b with clearly visible shelves and a box. The strip is plainly visible in m03, m16 and m14.
issues.fix: In the welcome-galley builder in src/10_mono.js (the block after `const gc = w / 2 - 0.3`): lighten the pane quad to about {c:'#6a645f', r:0.1, m:0.1}, or drop it and let the lit interior box (#5a5450, e 0.04) and shelves show through. Raise the interior emissive to about e:0.08 so the shelves read. Replace the tilted 0.05x0.66 sheen quad with an untilted, very low-contrast vertical band (#6f6d68, width 0.12, offset toward the hinge stile), or remove it. Keep the three shelf-shadow lines at #3a3835, thinner (0.006).

issues.detail: F front curtain (door-1 passage / F aisle)
issues.problem: Still hangs as a narrow (~0.45 m) free-standing pleated column in the middle of the passage (q01, m02), with gaps on both sides. In omaatF_40 the F curtains span the aisle opening from the ceiling and, when open, are gathered against the ink-cloud wall edge or the jamb.
issues.evidence: q01: the column spans x 395-530 of the 930 px frame, centred between the ebony walls. m02: the column at x 420-525 stands alone in front of the dark corridor. omaatF_40: the left curtain hangs at the wall edge under the EXIT sign.
issues.fix: In the class-curtain code in src/10_mono.js (the gathered/tied curtain section near line 762): for the F front curtain, either span the full aisle opening (x0..x1 of the passage, open-pleat geometry) or gather it against one jamb (offset the column centre by +-(passageW/2 - 0.22) toward the ink-cloud wall) and tie it like the J curtains.

issues.problem: A faint vertical seam is still visible in the lower part of the middle flap.
issues.fix: In buildAshWall, check whether the seam comes from the barAsh texture tiling or the monoBody face split. Offset the flap gRBox u-origin, or push the flap to F(x,1.28,0.008) so it fully covers the body seam.

issues.problem: The counter reads as mid-grey stone (#2d2c31 to #302f35) rather than the glossy near-black top in lalf_134 (#111119). Part of this is lighting.
issues.fix: Darken the welcome counter material to about #1a1a1e with r 0.15 so it picks up highlights like the real top.

issues.problem: The handle housing covers the door viewing window, which is still at the old aft position in 07_shell.js. This is not scored here, but it is visible in m17 and m18 until the shell hand-off lands.
issues.evidence: m18 shows no viewing window; lalf_133 shows it forward of the housing at about the arc's right end.
issues.fix: Shell: move wz to c-0.28 (from_monuments.md). No change in 10_mono.js.
